text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to help me determine the cause, could you please tell me how old you are and when your last period occurred?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with or without Atypia (or Endometrial Carcinoma).

Given your age and the adnexal mass, I need to check if the mass is ovary or uterus-related. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound (transvaginal). REQUEST TEST: Endometrial_Biopsy.
